slides.title: The problem

slides._comment: Exec summary — lead with the business impact number or statement, not telemetry.
slides.title: Post-sales success scales with headcount today — it should scale with intelligence
content: Consulting quality varies by consultant tenure, not customer need
Proven frameworks exist but live in tribal knowledge with no scalable delivery mechanism
Without consistent application of best practices: slower time-to-value, weaker renewals, reduced credibility

slides._comment: 3 findings/problems as icon cards. Use 4 icon cards+title for 4 items.
slides.title: Three structural failure patterns confirmed across all post-sales roles

cards.body: BI and CSM motions lack consistent frameworks across the team
cards.subcopy: Quality varies by consultant tenure, geography, and workload

cards.body: Can't map Dynatrace value signals to business outcomes across customer tiers
cards.subcopy: QBR and renewal quality varies significantly by individual

cards.body: Large accounts force multiple post-sales teams into a siloed approach
cards.subcopy: Inconsistent customer experience across regions and account tiers

slides.title: AI selects the right consulting framework and explains why — humans own every decision
content: Insights Forge evaluates customer context, selects from proven frameworks, and explains the rationale
Grounded in the GUIDE framework: Ground → Understand → Illustrate (AI activates here) → Drive → Evolve
Three user-facing phases, each ending at a human approval gate
Six critique lenses (MECE, ICE, Optimist, Consultative, Customer, Skeptic) stress-test every deliverable

slides._comment: Recommended actions as 3 text columns: action / owner / timeframe pattern.
slides.title: Recommended actions

columns.body: Authorize the Q3 2026 pilot: six accounts, 60 days, three roles — two BI, two CSM, two CSE
Day-30 checkpoint: go/no-go to expand across the full post-sales team. Success criteria defined before day 1
columns.subcopy: Metrics: time-to-first-deliverable, consultant satisfaction, IAT narrative consistency

columns.body: Full team onboarding if pilot confirms value against the three success criteria
columns.subcopy: Target: Q4 2026 · No production systems accessed at any stage

slides._comment: Decision required slide — use eyebrow 'Decision required', magenta accent on the ask.
slides.title: Approve a 60-day pilot across six accounts
content: Authorize Q3 2026 pilot: six accounts, 60 days, all three post-sales roles
No production systems accessed; the agent operates on conversation context only
Success metrics agreed before day 1 — day-30 review determines whether to expand to full team

slides._comment: Optional: appendix slide for supporting detail.
slides.title: Appendix — GUIDE framework detail
content: G — Ground: account maturity, vertical, consumption, AI adoption stage
U — Understand: success criteria (renewal, expansion, exec vs practitioner motion)
I — Illustrate: AI selects the right framework from the portfolio; explains the why
D — Drive: step sequencing, required artifacts, quality gates
E — Explain and evolve: why this framework, what signals changed, what comes next

slides._comment: Optional: wave background on a dark accent slide. wave_background names a key in WAVE_ASSETS ('wave-bg' for cover/closing, 'wave-ask' for decision-required). wave_overlay_opacity controls the dark overlay (0.0–1.0; default 0.80). Applies AFTER slide content is placed, so placeholders render on top of the wave.
slides.title: Approve a 60-day pilot
content: Go-ahead needed by end of Q3 to start the pilot cohort

slides._comment: Chart slide. 'Chart' is a dispatch key, not a template layout — the chart lands on Blank_graphic unless 'slide_layout' names another real layout. chart.type must be a valid XL_CHART_TYPE name (BAR_CLUSTERED, COLUMN_CLUSTERED, LINE, PIE, etc.). chart.left/top/width/height are in EMUs; omit them for the default inset position (0.5in/1.5in insets). Brand series colors (Teal → Magenta) are applied automatically, including line colors for LINE charts.
